attributes.action: Stop ageism in the recruitment process
attributes.additional_details: In a zero-barrier-to-entry industry, recruitment companies no longer respond to job applicants, and ghosting mid-life applicants is having devastating unintended effects. Only 10% of recruitment companies are members of the REC regulatory board, yet thousands operate in the UK today. Not legally required to track age-related data, currently, recruitment companies cannot be held legally accountable for age-related hiring bias.
attributes.background: We are calling on the government to tighten regulations in the HR industry to stop the unregulated use of AI tools that unfairly discriminate against middle-aged and older workers.

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: "Ban the use of AI in job recruitment processes" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/762292
